item.title: Missouri City woman says a trademark dispute is hurting her wings business
item.description: A Missouri City woman reached out to ABC13, upset by what she calls bullying from the master planned community where she lives and owns a business.

item.title: 'Scrubs' set visit: What it's like to be on set with Zach Braff, Donald Faison, Sarah Chalke
item.description: We're taking you to Vancouver and the set of "Scrubs" with Zach Braff, Donald Faison, Sarah Chalke and the whole gang. The highly-anticipated 'Scrubs' revival premieres Feb. 25 on ABC and streams the next day on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

item.title: Athlete of the Week: C.E. King sophomore Dillion Mitchell has eyes set on 2028 Summer Olympics
item.description: ABC13 highlights budding track star Dillion Mitchell who had already set a record at just 16-years-old and has his sights set on the big stage in two years.

item.title: Actor Eric Dane's unwavering advocacy for ALS was the most powerful role of his career
item.description: Actor Eric Dane's unwavering advocacy for ALS was the most powerful role of his career, and his work will continue to change lives even after his passing.

item.title: Houston police charge BBQ food truck owner with credit card abuse
item.description: Last year, 13 Investigates reported neighbors seeing thousands of dollars in charges from a business they say they never heard of. Now, the owner is facing felony charges.

item.title: New study finds over 90% of hair extensions tested contain harmful chemicals
item.description: A new study by Silent Spring Institute shows that hair extensions contain more harmful chemicals than experts previously thought.

item.title: How the Japanese locations in 'Rental Family' became more characters in the film
item.description: From city streets to historic restaurants to a unique digital art museum, the locations in "Rental Family" tell even more of the story. The film, starring Brendan Fraser, is streaming now on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

item.title: Man struck and killed by hit-and-run driver in east Harris County, sheriff says
item.description: Authorities are searching for a fleeing driver after a man was hit and killed in a crash in east Harris County, Sheriff Ed Gonzalez said.

item.title: HPD makes 20 arrests in South American crime ring connected to Houston, West U burglaries
item.description: Houston police have arrested 20 people in connection with a South American burglary ring and recovered $4 million in stolen property, according to investigators.

item.title: How Houstonians are helping those suffering from overdoses
item.description: A local non-profit is focusing on saving lives by distributing Narcan to those experiencing homelessness in Houston.
